positive_CR_objects.reason: For inter-system HO, direct data forwarding is not supported in case the source node or target node implements CP/UP separation. At bearer context setup or modification, the gNB CU CP may need to transfer mapping information between QoS Flows and data forwarding addresses to the gNB CU UP. Also for other handover cases, the CU-CP can provide data forwarding information to CU UP.
positive_CR_objects.summary:
The CU-CP may provide transport layer information to CU UP for handover data forwarding purposes.

 Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only has an impact on the handover function.

positive_CR_objects.reason:
The Cell Direction IE can be included in the Served Cell Information to indicate whether the cell is unidirectional, as agreed in R3-190956 as follows. 



But in the served cell information, in case of FDD, the UL/DL FreqInfo IEs and UL/DL Transmission Bandwidth (with corresponding UL/DL carrier list) are mandatory. This means if the cell is indicated as DL only cell, the UL FreqInfo/UL transmission bandwidth are indicated as well, which potentially lead to confusion. The same is true for UL only cell but with DL FreqInfo/DL transmission bandwidth.
positive_CR_objects.summary:
Update the semantic descriptions that for DL only cell, the UL related frequency information is ignored, while for UL only cell, the DL related frequency information is ignored.  

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
The impact can be considered isolated because the change only affects the served cell information.

positive_CR_objects.reason:
In served/neighbour information NR IE, the UL/DL NR frequency info and UL/DL transmission bandwidth are mandatory. 
However as indicated in the section 5.2 in TS 38.401, the SDL is operating in the DL operating band only. 

This means if the cell is SDL cell, the UL FreqInfo/UL transmission bandwidth are indicated as well, which may potentially lead to confusion and errors.  

Note that for LTE UL EARFCN in the Served Cell Information E-UTRA, it is already clearly indicated that 
Corresponds to NUL in TS 36.104 [25] for E-UTRA operating bands for which it is defined; ignored for E-UTRA operating bands for which NUL is not defined
Then the similar semantic descriptions can be included for NR UL frequency info as well.
positive_CR_objects.summary:
Update the semantic descriptions that for SDL cell, the UL related frequency information is ignored. 

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
The impact can be considered isolated because the change only affects the NR served/neighbour cell information.

positive_CR_objects.reason:
As observed from section 10.7.2 in TS 37.340, the MR-DC may be setup first, then the target MN triggers the path switch request procedure, where the updated security indication may be included in the Path Switch Request Acknowledge message as described in section 6.1.1 of TS 33.501.
 
Then the target MN needs to update the security indication in the M-NG-RAN node initiated S-NG-RAN node Modification.
positive_CR_objects.summary:
Add the security indication in the PDU Session Resource Modification Info – SN terminated IE in the SN modification request message, and the security result in the PDU Session Resource Modification Response Info – SN terminated IE in the SN modification request acknowledge message.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
The impact can be considered isolated because the change only affects the update of security indication for MR-DC.
